    input rst,
    input [1:0] opcode,
    input [3:0] operand,

);

                    stage <= 2'b11; // Move to Memory Access
                end
                2'b11: begin // Memory Access
                    stage <= 2'b00; // Move to Write Back
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

description: Create a simple sliding window protocol finite state machine (FSM) in Verilog. The FSM should have inputs for sending a packet and receiving an acknowledgment. The window size is fixed at 4 packets. The protocol should handle packet sending and acknowledgment properly while managing the state of the sender.

module sliding_window_protocol (
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input send_packet,
    input ack_received,
    output reg [1:0] window_start,
    output reg [1:0] window_end,
    output reg [3:0] sent_packets
);
    reg [1:0] state; // State: 0 - idle, 1 - sending, 2 - waiting for ack

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            state <= 0;
            window_start <= 0;
            window_end <= 0;
            sent_packets <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                0: begin
                    if (send_packet && (window_end - window_start < 4)) begin
                        sent_packets <= sent_packets + 1;
                        window_end <= window_end + 1;
                        state <= 1; // Move to sending state
                    end
                end
                1: begin
                    if (ack_received) begin
                        window_start <= window_start + 1;
                        state <= 2; // Move to waiting for ack state
                    end
                end
                2: begin
                    if (!ack_received) begin
                        state <= 0; // Go back to idle state
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

);

    input wire kick,
    input wire enable,
    output reg reset_signal
);

            reset_signal <= 0;
        end else if (enable) begin

                reset_signal <= 0;
            end else if (count < MAX_COUNT) begin

                reset_signal <= 0;
            end else begin

);

);

                y_out = (y_in < 15) ? (y_in + 1) : y_in; // move up

            end
            default: begin
                x_out = x_in;
                y_out = y_in;

    end

Design a Booth multiplier in Verilog that takes two 4-bit signed numbers as input and produces an 8-bit signed product as output. The multiplier should implement the Booth's algorithm to handle both positive and negative numbers correctly.

module booth_multiplier (
    input signed [3:0] A,
    input signed [3:0] B,
    output reg signed [7:0] P
);
    reg [3:0] Q;
    reg [3:0] M;
    reg [3:0] Q_1;
    reg [3:0] count;
    
    always @(*) begin
        M = A;  // Multiplicand
        Q = B;  // Multiplier
        Q_1 = 0; // Initialize Q-1
        P = 0;   // Initialize product
        
        for (count = 0; count < 4; count = count + 1) begin
            case ({Q[0], Q_1})
                2'b01: P = P + {M, 4'b0000}; // Add M to P
                2'b10: P = P - {M, 4'b0000}; // Subtract M from P
            endcase
            {P, Q} = {P[7:0], Q[3:1], Q[0]}; // Arithmetic right shift
            Q_1 = Q[0]; // Update Q-1
        end
    end
endmodule
